purpose: P0-2 submission gate: run an ICI positive-control biomarker with known cross-cohort reproducible evidence (Ayers et al. JCI 2017 IFN-gamma 6-gene signature; manuscript citation [1]) through the SAME frozen transport pipeline and two-criterion evaluation framework as the main analysis (S0), to test that the framework is not a trivial rejector.

signature.name: IFN-gamma 6-gene signature (Ayers et al., JCI 2017)
signature.score: mean of per-gene z-scores; z parameters frozen on the anchor cohort's labeled patients and transported unchanged

data_integrity_audit.status: INVALID: IMvigor210 exmat gene-row identity destroyed by upstream anonymization; positional exmat-row == fData-row lookup is FALSE
data_integrity_audit.upstream_provenance: mimifp/tfm_mUC (GitHub), 2_data/1_IMvigor210/exmat_censored_IMvigor210.csv -- README: 'All datasets ... have been anonymized because of the potential patentability of the results'
data_integrity_audit.sample_column_identity: VALID (header sample IDs; frozen y vectors reproduce exactly -- see identity_cross_checks)
data_integrity_audit.consequence: Every gene-level lookup into IMvigor210 exmat via fData row position ( frozen S0 '229 signature genes', and the IFN-gamma 6 rows here) addresses real expression rows whose true gene identity is UNKNOWN.  The frozen S0 numbers stand as computations, but the 322-gene identity claim is unsupported; the IFN-gamma positive control cannot be validly anchored on IMvigor210; upstream anonymization is irreversible (no gene key exists locally or upstream).

external_gene_mapping_validity.GSE165252: VALID (Ensembl IDs; CCL5 = ENSG00000271503 is the current Ensembl ID for CCL5, verified against ensembl.org)

frozen_pipeline.loaders: verbatim from pca_stability.py (load_imvigor / load_gse165252 / load_gse78220); raw matrices reconstructed from source files
frozen_pipeline.training: anchor cohort labeled patients; ridge logistic lambda=1/n_train, intercept unpenalised (verbatim // algebra)
frozen_pipeline.transport: z mean/sd and model coefficients frozen on the anchor, applied unchanged to ALL labeled patients of the target cohort (the same held-out sets as the main analysis)
frozen_pipeline.primary_scale: log1p(CPM) with FULL-matrix library size (the main-analysis normalisation chain up to the CLR step; CLR per-sample centring is specific to the 229-gene compositional panel and NOT applied to a 6-gene signature -- disclosed).  Sensitivity: raw values.
frozen_pipeline.metrics: verbatim  benchmark metric set (metrics_block from competitor_benchmark.py): AUC + 2000-rep bootstrap BCa 95% CI (seed 20260911), logit-scale calibration slope, calibration-in-the-large (intercept), Brier, log-loss; within-cohort Efron 0.632 (n_boot=600, seed 20260911), verbatim copy of _competitor_benchmark_.efron632_with the cohort loop parameterised

adjudication_rule.c1_main: external AUC bootstrap 95% CI excludes 0.5 in the beneficial direction (CI lower bound > 0.5)
adjudication_rule.tolerance_semantics: registered before execution: at tier t, C1 passes if CI lower bound > 0.5 - t; C2 passes if |slope - 1| <= t; tiers +/-0.05, +/-0.10, +/-0.20

as_specified_imvigor_anchored.caveat: IMvigor210 exmat rows carry no valid gene identity (see data_integrity_audit); these metrics measure 6 arbitrary mislabelled expression rows, NOT the Ayers IFN-gamma signature. Reported for record only; NOT a valid test of the framework.

IMvigor210.lambda_rule: 1/n (within-cohort n, intercept unpenalised; identical algebra to M2)
IMvigor210.formula: AUC_0.632 = 0.368 * AUC_apparent + 0.632 * mean(AUC_out-of-bag over 600 bootstrap refits)

salvage_positive_control.design: pre-registered adaptation: the two cohorts with VALID gene identities (GSE165252 Ensembl, GSE78220 HGNC symbols; both pre-treatment melanoma anti-PD-1, the indication in which the Ayers IFN-gamma signature was validated) are used as mutual frozen-transport anchors; identical machinery, identical metric set, identical adjudication; the same labeled held-out patient sets as the main analysis (all labeled patients of the target)

GSE165252.role: descriptive: conventional within-cohort z scoring (NOT the frozen transport); tests whether the signature carries ANY signal in each gene-valid cohort

GSE78220.role: descriptive: conventional within-cohort z scoring (NOT the frozen transport); tests whether the signature carries ANY signal in each gene-valid cohort

GSE165252.lambda_rule: 1/n (within-cohort n, intercept unpenalised; identical algebra to M2)
GSE165252.formula: AUC_0.632 = 0.368 * AUC_apparent + 0.632 * mean(AUC_out-of-bag over 600 bootstrap refits)

GSE78220.lambda_rule: 1/n (within-cohort n, intercept unpenalised; identical algebra to M2)
GSE78220.formula: AUC_0.632 = 0.368 * AUC_apparent + 0.632 * mean(AUC_out-of-bag over 600 bootstrap refits)

train_IMvigor210__test_GSE165252.note: S0 IMvigor210-anchored numbers rest on the same gene-row-invalid exmat (see audit); shown as the main analysis's own frozen numbers

train_IMvigor210__test_GSE78220.note: S0 IMvigor210-anchored numbers rest on the same gene-row-invalid exmat (see audit); shown as the main analysis's own frozen numbers

honest_report.p0_2_question: is the two-criterion frozen-transport framework a trivial rejector?
honest_report.as_specified_answer: NOT ANSWERABLE AS DESIGNED: the IMvigor210 anchor's expression matrix carries no valid gene identity (upstream anonymization; decisive sex-anchor audit); the as-specified IMvigor-anchored IFN-gamma run is reported for the record but measures mislabelled rows

salvage_answer.statement: (computed) salvage frozen transports between the two gene-valid melanoma anti-PD-1 cohorts: train_GSE165252__test_GSE78220: AUC 0.494 [0.247,0.721], slope 0.468, main-rule FAIL; train_GSE78220__test_GSE165252: AUC 0.553 [0.411,0.704], slope 1.953, main-rule FAIL

honest_report.go_no_go_note: The data-integrity finding is itself Go/No-Go critical input: the frozen S0's IMvigor210-anchored '322-gene' identity claim is unsupported by the deposited data, independent of the positive-control outcome.
